tasks.description: Verify deterministic digest, meaningful evolution, and no-op rejection.
Specify the smallest replaceable interface for a future code-writing agent. Do not implement network access or credentials.
Inspect repository Python sources for TODO/FIXME/HACK markers and source modules lacking conventional tests; report evidence-backed candidates without modifying files.
Discover repository improvement candidates and merge them into the persistent TASK_QUEUE.json without duplicating existing candidates or overwriting their statuses.
Generate a reviewable import-smoke-test patch for the task queue module; do not apply or execute the patch.
Generate and apply the bounded import-test patch inside a disposable sandbox; do not modify repository files or execute generated code.
Verify explicit viability bounds accept an in-bounds candidate and reject an out-of-bounds candidate without granting fitness, execution, or commit authority.
Verify local decision journal persistence, hash-chain validation, and tamper detection using temporary synthetic records; this does not authenticate evaluators or prove execution.

Evaluate a synthetic parent/candidate transition, persist the resulting evaluation receipt, reload it, and verify that decision, policy/evaluator identity, state digests, and fixture digest are preserved.
